title: Drága and Olcsó: Expensive and Cheap

sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: To describe whether something is expensive or cheap, put the adjective straight after the noun with no verb — Hungarian drops the copula in the third person.
A kenyér olcsó does NOT need van: 'A kenyér van olcsó' is wrong. Van is for existence and location ('there is / it's located'), never for linking a noun to a description like this.
